# ADR 0004: Append-only decisions enforced by the database

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** AML transaction monitoring

## Context

Case decisions are legal records.

## Decision

Revoke UPDATE/DELETE from the application role (or triggers) on decision tables.

## Consequences

Tamper-evident history even if the application has bugs.

## Alternatives considered

Soft deletes in code only.
